test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Consider the statements given below and identify the correct answer.

**Statement-I:** Washing soda is produced from sodium chloride.

**Statement-II: **It attacks dirt and grease to form water soluble products, which are then washed away on rinsing with water.

options.text: Statement-I is true, and Statement-II is false.
Statement-II is true, and Statement-I is false.

solution:
The correct answer is __**both the statements are true**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement-I:** Washing soda is produced from sodium chloride.

 
 
• This statement is true.
 
• **Washing soda**, also known as **sodium carbonate** (Na₂CO₃), is produced from sodium chloride (NaCl) through the Solvay process.
 
• The **Solvay process **involves the reaction of sodium chloride with ammonia and carbon dioxide in water to form sodium bicarbonate, which is then heated to produce sodium carbonate (washing soda).
 
 
 
• **Statement-II:** It attacks dirt and grease to form water soluble products, which are then washed away on rinsing with water.
 
 
• This statement is also true.
 
• Washing soda is an effective cleaning agent because it can react with the fatty acids in grease and dirt to form soluble salts, which can be easily rinsed away with water.
 
 
 
• Since both Statement-I and Statement-II are true, the correct answer is option 2.
